about_the_game:
Game Overview

Wolfstone Pine is a first-person horror experience set in a remote national park where daylight exploration and nighttime terror cross paths. By day you'll need to search the abandoned trails, cabins and locations to uncover supplies in an attempt to escape the strange location. But when the sun sets, the forest become a hunting ground, for the darkness.

Balance exploration and environmental storytelling with time management as you piece together what happened in the forest to other visits and why the park's authority enforce such a strict curfew. 

Wolfstone Pine blends atmospheric tension with a grounded national-park realism to create a world that feels authentic, lived and and quietly wrong.

Wolfstone Pine National Park

Established in 1974 and managed by Wolfstone Regional Parks Authority. The park covers 42,800 acres of protected old-growth forest, wetlands and highland terrain.

It a a heavily forested reserve known for its dense forest. Despite it's name, there are little to-no pine trees in the national park, it is predominantly a Beech forest. The park attracts hikers, campers and nature enthusiasts that seek solitude and unspoiled wilderness. Due to it's isolation and limited road access, visitors are advised to plan ahead and follow safety guidelines.

Camping is only permitted on marked campgrounds or in clear areas around the designated cabins. Cabins can be rented from the Wolfstone Ranger Station before entering the park. We recommend booking in advance, so you don't miss out. Solo camping is discouraged. For visitor safety, no hiking or trail use is permitted after sunset; trails are unlit and can become hazardous in low visibility.

Search by day, hide by night

Visitors are encouraged to explore Wolfstone Pine only during the daylight hours. During this time, please take advantage of the open forest terrain. As dusk settles over the western ridgelines, the Wolfstone Regional Parks Authority advises all guests to return to marked shelters and secure their doors.

Rumors spread by locals include that of a 'Creature in the Darkness' that is said to emerge only after the full darkness of night has been revealed. Officials attribute the tales to misidentified wildlife and the Wolfstone Regional Parks Authority deny anything unusual.

Key Features

  • Search cabins and campsites for supplies and clues

  • Piece together the park's strange history through notes and environmental storytelling

  • Hide and stay silent as an unseen predator roams the forest

  • Discover hidden secrets of a region with plenty to hide

  • Day/Night cycle with dynamic weather conditions

  • A solo-developed, fully hand crafted world built with care, mystery and emotional weight

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages. It includes horror themes, jump scares and intense chase sequences.

  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5 4690
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: Explore the abandoned trails and forgotten cabins of Wolfstone Pine by day and survive the night by staying in doors. Search for supplies, uncover the park's buried history and stay hidden until sunrise as you plan your escape from the strange national park.
